profile.name: Karsten Palmer
profile.about: contact me at me@karstenpalmer.com, always open to a good opportunity
recommendations: Ray Del Vecchio “Karsten is a great engineer! He was able to jump into almost any new codebase of ours across frontend, backend, data pipes, mobile apps, and infra to debug, make quick fixes, and add new features that fit our codebase standards, practices, and quality bar. If you need good stuff shipped fast, he's the guy!”

Omar Abdelaziz “Karsten is one of the most impressive people I've ever met - while in high school, Karsten figured out how to rebuild Blue (an iOS voice assistant that can control any app on your phone) from scratch including writing firmware code, making the iOS app, and creating a server calling different model endpoints in a loop. Extremely impressive! He did all this then he reached out with you a YouTube video showing us what he had built. He even ran into some of the same challenges we were running into and came up with novel solutions. The whole company was floored seeing his video and getting to meet Karsten in person! I highly recommend Karsten to any university or employer - Karsten is in the top 0.1%!”

volunteer_experience.info: I provide one-on-one academic support and mentorship to elementary and middle school students through Healthy Cities Tutoring. My role focuses on helping students build confidence, strengthen core skills, and develop effective study habits. I work to create a supportive and encouraging learning environment tailored to each student’s needs, with the goal of fostering both academic growth and personal development.
volunteer_experience.subtitle: Healthy Cities Tutoring
volunteer_experience.title: Academic Tutor

volunteer_experience.info: I co-founded the AI Club to create a space for students to explore artificial intelligence, machine learning, and related technologies. I help organize workshops, discussions, and hands-on projects that introduce members to real-world applications of AI. Through collaboration and exploration, our club empowers students to build technical skills, stay curious about emerging technology, and think critically about the ethical and societal impacts of AI.
volunteer_experience.subtitle: AI Club
volunteer_experience.title: Co-Founder

volunteer_experience.info: I founded Tech Care of You in order to provide one-on-one tech support to elderly or anyone that needs it. I have always been a tech enthusiast and I wanted to help out my local community. This experience has been incredibly rewarding.
volunteer_experience.subtitle: Tech Care of You
volunteer_experience.title: Founder
